display_name: Combined percentage of recording duration with < 90% oxygen saturation from either type III home sleep apnea test or type I polysomnography
description: Legacy variable created by the PVDOMICS study team by combining the percentage of recording time with < 90% oxygen saturation (:pctlt90_pvd:) from the PVDOMICS core study protocol with similar variable from the alternative studies (:pctlt90_alt:)
